SigourneyEnable.description: Enables weaving the assembly with Sigourney after compilation.

SigourneyRegisteredTargetFiles.deprecationMessage: SigourneyRegisteredTargetFiles is deprecated. You can name your target files MyPackage.targets and NuGet will automatically import them.
SigourneyRegisteredTargetFiles.description: A semicolon-separated list of files with weaver targets.

SigourneyRegisteredTargets.description: A semicolon-separated list of weaver targets.

SigourneyConfiguration.description: Opaque configuration for Sigourney, to be passed to the Configuration property of weaver tasks. Do not modify manually.

SigourneyEntryPoint.description: Runs weaver targets declared in the SigouenryRegisteredTargetFiles property.
